heading_en: Transitional Measures Concerning Exposures to Equity and Instruments Having the Same Nature as Equity
summary_ja: 株式等エクスポージャーのリスク・ウェイトにつき五年間の段階的経過措置を定める。
summary_en: Provides five-year phased transitional risk weights for equity exposures, with an option for IRB institutions to use the larger of the old and new weights.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach may, with respect to the risk weight of exposures to equity and instruments having the same nature as equity (meaning instruments having the same nature as equity prescribed in Article 43, paragraph (2) of the New Public Notice; the same applies in paragraph (4)), for the period until the day on which five years have elapsed from the Application Date, notwithstanding that Article, apply the risk weight prescribed in each of the following items according to the category of investment set out in that item: (i) Investments in speculative unlisted equities prescribed in Article 43, paragraph (3) of the New Public Notice: the risk weight prescribed in each of (a) through (e) below according to the period category set out in that sub-item: (a) For one year from the Application Date: 100%; (b) For one year from the day on which one year has elapsed from the Application Date: 160%; (c) For one year from the day on which two years have elapsed from the Application Date: 220%; (d) For one year from the day on which three years have elapsed from the Application Date: 280%; (e) For one year from the day on which four years have elapsed from the Application Date: 340%. (ii) Investments other than those set out in the preceding item: the risk weight prescribed in each of (a) through (e) below according to the period category set out in that sub-item: (a) For one year from the Application Date: 100%; (b) For one year from the day on which one year has elapsed from the Application Date: 130%; (c) For one year from the day on which two years have elapsed from the Application Date: 160%; (d) For one year from the day on which three years have elapsed from the Application Date: 190%; (e) For one year from the day on which four years have elapsed from the Application Date: 220%.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach (meaning an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach prescribed in Article 1, item (iii) of the New Public Notice; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) may, in calculating the amount of credit risk-weighted assets for equity exposures (meaning equity exposures prescribed in Article 1, item (ix) of the New Public Notice; the same applies in the following paragraph), for the period until the day on which five years have elapsed from the Application Date, notwithstanding Article 143 of the New Public Notice, use for the investments set out in the items of the preceding paragraph the larger of the risk weight prescribed in the relevant item and the risk weight calculated by the methods set out in the items of Article 143, paragraph (1) of the Former Public Notice. In this case, where it uses the risk weight calculated pursuant to that paragraph, the calculation of the amount of credit risk-weighted assets and the expected loss amount, and the treatment of eligible provisions (meaning eligible provisions prescribed in Article 1, item (vi) of the New Public Notice), shall remain governed by the provisions then in force; provided, however, that Article 143, paragraphs (5), (6) and (8) of the Former Public Notice do not apply, and the adjustment of multiplying the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets prescribed in Article 128, item (i) of the Former Public Notice by 1.06 is not required.
Where the provisions of the preceding paragraph are applied, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall apply that paragraph to all equity exposures.

The provisions of paragraph (1) apply mutatis mutandis to the determination of the risk weight of exposures to equity and instruments having the same nature as equity in the following cases. In this case, the words "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach" in that paragraph shall be read as "Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach": (i) Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach calculates the amount of required capital calculated by the standardized approach prescribed in Article 13, paragraph (3) of the New Public Notice; (ii) Where an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach calculates the total amount of credit risk-weighted assets for the portion to which the standardized approach is applied.
